note: Cleric in a long white robe, front view. Hair, beard and long side hair are head, beard bottom y~460 (hair ends y~442 at the sides where the white hood collar starts). Collar, robe, belt and straps, and the dark purple cloak panels at both hips are torso. The robe hangs to y~840, so hip = robe hem y840; the covered thighs get no labels and only the boots below the hem are labelled lower leg (y840-877, top of the boots is the hem) and foot (ankle at the instep y877). Arms are wide bell sleeves with no marked elbow, so elbows are halfway shoulder to wrist: left (image left) shoulder y~462, elbow y548, wrist y622 where the small pale hand shows under the cuff (hand y622-684) beside the mace head; right shoulder y~468, elbow y557, wrist y~640, pale hand y638-705. The mace head (grey ball x222-328, y562-697) is equipment, kept off the hand; its handle is hidden. The robe, sleeves and collar are white, which the foreground estimate may drop; they are labelled by convention.
